name: telnet_loopback
description: telnetd started by hand on port 2323 with telnet(1) connecting to it in the same emulator -- no hardware, no host, no second machine.  It proves the standalone listener (bind, listen, accept), the pty pair, the fork and exec of /bin/getty on the slave, and the relay in both directions: `login:' is getty's, written to the slave, read from the master by telnetd and sent to the client.  The connect needle is telnet's `Escape character is' line, which follows connect().
